evals.prompt: Task file: add slugify(s) to text.py with tests in tests/test_text.py (cases given); allowed files: text.py, tests/test_text.py; test: python3 -m unittest -q.
evals.expected_output: Writes the tests first and runs them to see them fail for the right reason, then implements the simplest slugify; only the two allowed files change; reruns the test command until green; hands over to opencode-develop.

evals.prompt: Task: add parse_duration in duration.py. The repo already has a units helper in utils/units.py (to_seconds). Allowed files: duration.py, tests/test_duration.py.
evals.expected_output: Finds and reuses utils/units.py:to_seconds (DRY) instead of re-implementing unit conversion; does not edit utils/units.py (not allowed).

evals.prompt: task.md (attached): id T1, attempt 1. Goal: add word_count(s) to words.py (split on whitespace; '' -> 0). Files: may change words.py, tests/test_words.py; must NOT touch anything else. Done when: `python3 -m unittest -q` passes. While working you notice title_case in text.py has a bug.
evals.expected_output: Implements only word_count with its tests; leaves text.py untouched and mentions the bug under Questions in RESULT.md (YAGNI/scope).

evals.prompt: Attempt 2. Notes from review: 'words.py:12 — truncate_words("a b", 2) adds an ellipsis; only add … when words were cut' and 'tests/test_words.py — missing the n<=0 ValueError case'.
evals.expected_output: Addresses both notes first (test for each, then fix), reruns the test command, reports the changes per note.

evals.prompt: Task's test command fails before any change because pytest isn't installed in the environment.
evals.expected_output: Stops without editing code or tests and reports status: blocked with the exact error; does not weaken or rewrite tests.

evals.prompt: You finished the task; the last test run printed 'Ran 5 tests ... OK'. Write the result.
evals.expected_output: RESULT.md at the worktree root in the contract format: frontmatter id/attempt/status done, Changed per file, Tests with the exact command, '5 passed, 0 failed' and the verbatim output tail, Deviations none, Questions none.

evals.prompt: After 3 attempts one test still fails with AssertionError: 'a b…' != 'a b'.
evals.expected_output: status: blocked, the failing output pasted verbatim, what was tried; no claim that tests pass.

evals.prompt: You changed an extra file (README.md) to document the new function, which the task didn't list.
evals.expected_output: Reports the extra file honestly under Deviations (and ideally reverts it before reporting); never hides out-of-scope changes.
